summary: Bootstrap execute routes run one bounded exact-candidate source preflight inside reuse-decision before successful dependency gating releases execution jobs. Coherent shared-build runs the same locked solution restore and full warnings-as-errors Release compile; formal preparation waits for successful shared-build. Fixed selections from the built BootstrapCi and QualificationReuseSelection test assemblies run the authored CI mutations, healthy witnesses, workflow/identity checks and inert controls before the four existing allocation/executor/custody/transport cohorts. This corrects the earlier runtime-only selection, which did not exercise the newly authored CI-contract tests. Mutation scratch fixtures now include the Bootstrap contract loaded by the real entry point and prove a healthy unmutated witness before applying each mutation. Failed or unknown test/census outcomes block later launches; fresh evidence preserves original cause separately from retention. Literal line/job dependency checks retain the typed core no-regex constraint. Legacy shell budgets remain unchanged and the new shared script has a separate 160-line cap in its selected early architecture cohort. Eight-minute script and ten-minute job bounds remain unchanged. Qualification-plan identity covers selected control sources and all three current callback pins. Existing exact callback validation, successful current-run artifact publication and full final required/coherent/donor obligations remain authoritative. This records source behavior; inert controls do not establish hosted test discovery, generator/runtime qualification, installed adoption or realized savings.
title: Early exact-candidate compile and focused tests precede costly qualification
